# Test Images

This directory contains sample images for testing file upload functionality.

## Required Images

The following images should be placed in this directory for the tests to work:

1. `test-page-image.jpg` - Sample page image (102KB)
2. `test-seo-image.jpg` - Sample SEO image (153KB)
3. `test-quill-image.jpg` - Sample image for Quill editor (82KB)
4. `updated-page-image.jpg` - Updated page image (128KB)
5. `updated-seo-image.jpg` - Updated SEO image (113KB)

## Image Requirements

- Format: JPEG
- Size: Between 50KB and 200KB
- Dimensions: 800x600 pixels or similar
- Content: Any sample images (landscapes, abstract, etc.)

## Creating Test Images

You can create these images using any image editing software or download sample images from:
- https://picsum.photos/ (random images)
- https://unsplash.com/ (free stock photos)
- https://pexels.com/ (free stock photos)

## Note

These images are only used for testing purposes and should not contain any sensitive or copyrighted content.
